Package com.smartlostfound.storage

Interface ItemStorageService

All Known Implementing Classes:
CsvItemStorageService, MongoItemStorageService
public interface ItemStorageService
Interface defining the persistence operations for lost and found items. Allows decoupling the storage implementation (e.g. CSV, JSON, Database) from the business logic layer.
